text_zh:
余韵护盾 · D-11 类节律保留器

分发对象：已完成当月连续产出基准评估、评级不低于 C+ 的在岗抄录员。

本器材用于在抄录节律发生非预期中断时，留存雇员既有产能状态的部分登记记录，以备中断后的恢复核算使用。

操作规范：
—— 本器材由物资管理中心统一配给，不接受个人申领。配发前需签署节律中断情况声明表（编号 D-11/C）。
—— 持有者报告：节律中断发生时，器材表面温度轻微下降，纸张翻动声在约两秒内停止。原因不明，已录入行为档案，待复审委员会核查。
—— 本器材未通过外勤认证，禁止携出本楼层工作区域。已发生 7 起因违规携出导致登记记录异常清零的事件，相关雇员工号已提交政策协调员办公室备案。
—— 损毁、遗失或出现使用须知以外的异常现象，请勿自行处理，第一时间通知维修组并暂停当日抄录任务。
—— 调岗或离职时，本器材须连同 D-11/C 声明表存根一并归还 HR，不予补发，未归还将影响离职结算流程。
text_en:
Lingering Shield · D-11 Rhythm Retention Unit

Issued to: Active scribes who have completed the current month's continuous output baseline assessment with a rating no lower than C+.

This unit is issued to log and retain a partial record of an employee's established output status in the event of an unscheduled transcription rhythm interruption, for use in post-interruption recovery reconciliation.

Operating Guidelines:
—— This unit is distributed exclusively through the Supply Management Centre. Individual requisitions are not accepted. Recipients must sign a Rhythm Interruption Declaration Form (ref. D-11/C) prior to issuance.
—— Holders have reported that during rhythm interruption events, the surface temperature of the unit decreases slightly, and the sound of paper turning ceases within approximately two seconds. Cause undetermined. Logged in behavioural records, pending review by the Audit Committee.
—— This unit has not been cleared for field use and must not be removed from the designated floor work area. Seven incidents of anomalous record clearance have been recorded following unauthorised removal. Employee numbers of the personnel involved have been submitted to the Policy Coordination Office for filing.
—— In the event of damage, loss, or any abnormal occurrence not covered by these guidelines, do not attempt to address the issue independently. Notify the Maintenance Team immediately and suspend all transcription tasks for the remainder of the day.
—— Upon reassignment or departure, this unit must be returned to HR together with the D-11/C declaration form stub. No replacement will be issued. Failure to return the unit will affect the final settlement process.
